correctionNotes: For a bass-boosted Crinacle-style target, add a clean sub/low-bass shelf rather than mid-bass hump; keep 150–250 Hz controlled to avoid wooden-cup warmth turning muddy.
Trim the 2.5–3 kHz presence peak modestly if vocals/guitars feel too forward; the target still needs natural presence, so avoid over-cutting.
Smooth 6–9 kHz with gentle cuts for edge/sibilance; do not chase the deep ~10 kHz notch because it is likely measurement/rig dependent.
A small air shelf above ~12 kHz can restore openness, but keep it conservative because the graph becomes less reliable in the upper treble.
